era: LocalWiki as served through 2019 (Arquivo captures Mar, Jun and Sep 2019 of the home page, Apr 2019 of the Oakland and San Francisco region pages): grey header bar with the green localwiki logo, search field, Explore / About / Blog / Donate / API / Help and log in / create account, full-width photo hero 'LocalWiki is a grassroots effort to collect, share and open the world's local knowledge', Explore LocalWiki region tiles and Recent blog posts. The site has not been redesigned since; the theme adds nothing and keeps the site as it is.
